recommendation: Keep the empty no-change audit commit. No core FHIR follow-up is needed for FHIR-32459 unless the Security Work Group opens a new issue to add typed network address metadata after the later FHIR-39116 decision.
issue_request: The Published FHIR-core AuditEvent issue asked whether AuditEvent.agent.network.type should draw on ContactPoint.system codes for voice phone, SMS, fax, and similar distinctions. The Not Persuasive with Modification resolution replaced the old AuditEvent.agent.network backbone with AuditEvent.agent.network[x] 0..1, permitting Reference(Endpoint), uri, and string with endpoint-oriented definition, requirements, and comment guidance.
initial_application: Git commit 3d204189e23e03f0b4f11d03d491bc1d868e399b, "security block vote updates: FHIR-33020, FHIR-32466, FHIR-32450, and FHIR-32459", removed AuditEvent.agent.network.address and AuditEvent.agent.network.type, including the required ValueSet/network-type binding, and added AuditEvent.agent.network[x] with Reference(Endpoint), uri, and string. Current source/fhir.ini keeps AuditEvent active and maps the old R4 network.address/type paths to network[x].
additional_context: Security WG minutes for 2021-09-13 record the FHIR-32459 block vote disposition and 8-0-1 approval. A later Published issue, FHIR-39116, asked to bring AuditEvent.agent.network.type back for IP address semantics, but resolved by clarifying network[x] string encoding guidance instead; that later issue is already separately audited on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. The active AuditEvent StructureDefinition already has AuditEvent.agent.network[x] with Reference(Endpoint), uri, and string and no active binding to ContactPoint.system or the old network-type value set; only historical OID registry entries for network-type remain.

related_jiras.note: Addressed old network.address optionality under the R4 backbone model; the FHIR-32459 network[x] replacement and cross-version mappings cover the old address/type paths.
Asked to bring back AuditEvent.agent.network.type, but the Published resolution clarified string encoding guidance instead and is already separately audited on the combined branch.
